source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 2 June 1961, p. 9 ("Results: county and rural council elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the members returned read in the Strabane Chronicle of 20 May 1961, p. 7, and the Glenmornan count in the News-Letter of 2 June 1961.

note: Triennial election of Strabane Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Glenmornan was the only division contested; the other 27 members were returned unopposed, making 20 Unionists and 8 Nationalists. Printed: 'Glenmorlan (the only district contested) - Elected - James M'Cormick (outgoing) 115; not elected - Daniel Rouse (65).' The News-Letter spells the division 'Glenmorlan'; the form used here is Glenmornan.
